scope: Bind the complete DE-W089 supplied-reader directory index/bitmap graph collector to a held Windows ordinary file with explicit and automatic NTFS3.0/3.1 selection, source checks, exact retained response replay and finite original quotas. No namespace/collation/target-membership, worker/public dispatch, physical source, writer or original0.1.0 completion is implied.
ownership: Extend existing providers/image/ntfs_file.h/.cpp and its normal/fault probes; reuse local_file pins/path/metadata, existing read/response retention and process epoch. Runtime/capture remains the source/format meaning owner. Do not introduce a second opener, parser, scheduler, production library, generic source framework or speculative hierarchy. Preserve default bootstrap output/domain/read order and all existing consumers.
inputs: NtfsDirectoryFileRequest owns the existing NtfsFileRequest plus full reference and NtfsDirectoryLimits. Freeze all nested values, expected metadata, stop predicate and test controls before callbacks. Validate profile enum, reference and directory/capture limits, bounded expected metadata and signed native volume window before opening. Automatic, Version30 and Version31 are all supported. Zero reference selects reserved root ordinal5 through the runtime collector; other references require nonzero high16 sequence. Source metadata is a precondition, not read/effect authority.
binding: Reuse fixed-local ordinary-path checks and pinned ancestor generations, one GENERIC_READ/FILE_SHARE_READ/OPEN_EXISTING/OPEN_REPARSE_POINT handle, exact expected metadata and source/window checks. Source/process ID, creation time, nonwrapping sequence and metadata hash are observed. Before/after every native read, check source/path/ancestor binding and stop predicate. Preserve seek/read attempts, refusals, errors and bytes for every requested response. Keep the same handles through selected collection, pure replay and final checks. No fallback, mount, elevation or writes.
profiles: Explicit profiles run the selected directory observer once and preserve mismatch/refusal. Automatic starts the3.1 directory observer. A supported observed3.1 uses that result. Only a source-bound ntfs_volume_version refusal with Volume3.0 may select3.0; mirror/bootstrap prerequisites must already have passed. Unknown versions and other bootstrap failures do not trigger a retry. Automatic3.0 must not reissue the native bootstrap or merely relabel the incomplete result.
prefix_validation: For Automatic3.0, retain the exact original prefix response count. First run the3.0 directory observer against only that prefix; the first new response request deliberately stops this pure validation pass. Require exact full response provenance/extent/bytes/order and complete prefix consumption before any new native read. Compare explicit common bootstrap fields with the3.1 probe: schema/source/epoch/window/major, authority flags, boot, primary/mirror/used-payload agreement, MFT, Volume FILE/information, retained regions/bytes, attributes/runs, requested directory reference and MFT/Volume closures. Only Volume.profile_matches is normalized to true; requested minor and downstream completion/diagnostics/read-attempt counters are separate. Any disagreement withdraws profile applicability and forbids native continuation.
continuation: If validated3.0 needs a new response, rerun the3.0 directory observer with a strict retained prefix followed by the same live native reader. Compare every prefix response before use and fail immediately on corruption/throw/extent mismatch or incomplete consumption, before suffix I/O. A deterministic prefix already validated under3.0 may then continue to new directory reads and the usual final rereads. Actual retained responses and native requests must equal the single explicit3.0 collection trace: cached prefix replays add no native calls, quota resets, source openings or stop callbacks. A legitimate pre-directory refusal needing no new response keeps that selected partial result without native continuation.
replay: After the complete selected live collection, capture after metadata through the existing checks/hook, then replay the selected directory observer solely over all retained responses. Require complete response consumption, exact request extents and exact observation equality, including partial/error prefixes; no native reads or live stop callbacks during replay. Final metadata/pins are checked afterwards. Prefix-validation/resume/final replay counts and hashes are distinguishable. Refusal or changed/error responses never become successful collection just because replay agrees.
receipt: Use a separate private org.disked.ntfs-directory-file-capture/1 wrapper. Domain provider ntfs-directory-file-prototype binds actual source/process/sequence, window, selector/selected profile, existing capture limits and exact directory reference/limits. Keep bootstrap domain/schema unchanged. New capture facts bind original probe hash/count, normalized foundation hashes, prefix-validation result hash, consumed/reused counts, boundary and continuation observations, profile agreement and final replay. All values own their storage. Metadata completeness/equality, binding checks, directory/index/bitmap completeness, replay agreement and observed stability stay separate; atomic/current-source/namespace/collation/global allocation/effect/public-dispatch claims remain false.
bounds: Every actual response is retained at most once and charged to the unchanged capture read-request/read-byte limits, including all live rereads. Both3.0 prefix passes use already retained bounded bytes and the same logical observer limits; no extra native budget. Directory entry/block/bitmap and observer output limits remain unchanged. Outer JSON stays within existing4MiB; prefix reports need only hashes plus bounded selected facts, not unbounded copies. Cooperative stop is not a native I/O deadline; worker containment remains required before frontend admission.
testing: Extend the existing DISKED_NTFS_FILE_TESTING-only seam; production has no fault environment protocol. Independently construct actual disposable files from the directory sparse recipes. Expected full read sequences/hashes and directory facts precede evaluation. Cover both versions/explicit/automatic, legacy FILE headers, root/empty/multilevel/fragmented/list/bitmap cases, nonzero/>4GiB offsets, full references/names, native source/pin exclusion and release, each prefix/live/final replay fault, request/callback mutation, metadata/binding/cancel failure and exact quota boundaries. Preserve old bootstrap/file/worker/public NTFS and shared ordinary-file regressions. Unavailable symlink/host checks remain explicitly unverified.
acceptance: Actual generated ordinary files produce independently expected source-bound directory index/bitmap/name/reference/read/hash facts for automatic and explicit3.0/3.1, with full source hashes unchanged. Automatic3.0 has the same native trace as explicit3.0, with no reopened source or extra native bootstrap.

Prefix provenance/foundation disagreement prevents new native reads; exact prefix continuation and final pure replay retain partial/error/cancel observations and withdraw applicability on any disagreement. Validate limits before opening and preserve held source/ancestor exclusion and later release.

Build normal/fault compositions, standalone headers, PE/import and build ownership checks; run new independent directory-file cases, relevant old directory/capture/closure/stream/file/worker/frontend/local-file/exFAT regressions, complete tooling and source-bound context/manifest checks. Retain exact commands/inputs/artifact hashes, failures and actual tested host limits. Agent review does not grant owner, release, physical or worker/frontend authority.
